shots.title: ASHES OF THE CONCORD
shots.caption: Haldis Reach. Day eighty-nine of the ninety the ceasefire allowed.
The Concord is leaving the world it fought six years to keep. The evacuation tender Cinder Wake is one of the last ships out.
Its cargo manifest lists twenty medical archive cores. Nobody aboard has asked what that means.

shots.speaker: warden
shots.caption: 0612 SHIP TIME. CUSTODIAN HANDSHAKE RECEIVED. ORIGIN: CABIN 4-C. LOGGING.
At Muster Point B, Purser Dray counts the passengers, and then counts them again.
In Transfer Cabin 4-C, a discharged Lattice operator is trying very hard to sleep.
The docking clamps let go with a sound like a held breath released.
The Petrel slides out through Bay 2's shimmering field, into the dark above Haldis Reach.
